A [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] '''Superfreighter''' with a cargo of [[Vulture-class starfighter/Legends|droid starfighters]] was [[Battle of Lok (32 BBY)|attacked]], disabled, and forced to crash on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Lok/Legends|Lok]] in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]]. The [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Nym/Legends|Nym]] led his [[Lok Revenants/Legends|band]] in a raid on a Trade Federation [[Convoy/Legends|convoy]], of which the [[Trade Federation Superfreighter|vessel]] was part of. Nym disabled the vessel, which launched its cargo in a vain defense. The vessel crashed on Lok, and Nym sent one of his own [[Freighter/Legends|freighters]] to retrieve the cargo. The Federation sent another [[Freighter/Legends|Superfreighter]] to recover it, but it was also destroyed. The Revenants secured the downed Superfreighter's cargo and returned to [[Nym's Base|base]]. The cargo contained a transmitter which later led a Trade Federation attack force to the base.

==Behind the scenes==
The Trade Federation Superfreighter appears in the [[2001]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars: Starfighter (video game)|''Star Wars: Starfighter'']]. The player, in the guise of Nym, must attack one of several Superfreighters in the convoy and disable it. It crashes on the planet in the cutscene and the next mission is to recover the cargo.
